_comment: Headset standing-mode effects per era (Implementation Plan 2.6; product doc 'Standing modes'). Calibrated estimates, not measured: FastF1 can't observe them. Start modest, tune by playtesting. lapDelta: s added per lap. wearMult: multiplies tyre wear (effective tyre age advances by this per lap). errorMult: multiplies the era's base error rate; only the excess over 1 is applied. attackLogit / defendLogit: added to the overtake model's logit when this car attacks / is attacked. teamOrders (product doc decision type; estimates to tune in playtests): holdUpLogit is added to the rival's pass logit while the user's teammate defends directly ahead of it; holdUpCost is the time the teammate loses per lap doing so; swapWindow is how close (s) the user and teammate must be to swap; swapCost is what the yielding car loses; swapLaps is how long a swap call stays open. neutralization: base rates for grader playouts, which don't know the race's future (spec decision Oct 26 2026): chance per lap that a SC / VSC starts and their typical length, measured over the 32-race validation set (12 SC and 24 VSC starts in 1931 racing laps; median 5 and 2 laps). ers (feedback round 2, live play only): the hybrid battery. Each mode's charge is the battery % it gains (+) or spends (-) a green lap; a SC/VSC lap recharges scCharge; a car starts with startBattery. A spending mode does nothing with the battery empty. incidents (round 2, live play only; estimates, not measured): per-car chances each green lap of a crash, a mechanical failure and a puncture. A puncture costs punctureCost and forces a stop; a crash retires the car and brings out a SC (scShare) or a VSC on the next lap; a failure retires it. Multipliers: push (pace) on failures and punctures, attack/defend within PASS_WINDOW on crashes, punctures per lap of wear past the cliff, up to punctureMax a lap. engineer (race engineer spec, Nov 3 2026, live play only; estimates to tune in playtests): battle moves for one lap against the car directly ahead (attacks) or behind (defences) within battleWindow: attackLogit/defendLogit shift that pass roll, lapDelta is the time the move costs, contact multiplies contactBase (a contact is a front wing with wingDamage s/lap until a stop, which costs noseCost more; a puncture; or a spin costing spinCost), strike multiplies the track-limit strike chance, battery is what the overtake button spends. wait-drs gives the next lap's attack drsLogit. Track limits: strikeBase a green lap (x strikePush pushing, x strikeCareful when careful, which costs carefulCost a lap); penalty s at strike penaltyAt and every penaltyEvery after, added at the flag. blue: a lapped car within window ahead on track: waiting for the blue flags costs nothing extra (the measured lap times already include traffic); going round him at once gains goRoundGain but adds goRoundContact. trust: the driver starts at start - perIgnore x his ignores % (min..max); deltas per reason; settles by settle a lap after settleAfter quiet laps; more than ordersLimit headset orders within 3 laps is micromanaging; a refused request is judged after watch laps. Moods by trust (calm/tense/frustrated lower edges); a frustrated or furious driver overdrives (moodEffects), and a furious one picks his own battle moves.
